_comment: kit shader asset baseline -- golden fingerprints for app/tool/preflight.ps1 step 7.5.
Why: the flip-text scan catches the platform y-flip coming back (final_render 2/2,
filter 1/1, arbitrary 2/2), but geometry_blended is 0-flip in BOTH the repo-recipe
build and the current asset while their sha256 differ (AAC7DE66.. vs C3C8DDE1..).
So the flip scan alone cannot cover it; this baseline covers all four.
Rule: if an asset is intentionally changed, update the fingerprints here in the same
commit and say why in the commit message -- otherwise the gate must FAIL.
Evidence for the current values: docs/着色器分支普查与风险登记.md (census)
and docs/真折射移植计划.md 0.1.36 (landed conditional assets).
note_skSL: The SkSL stage in an .iplr does NOT start with '#version' (it starts with a spirv-cross banner), so the flip-text scan skips it. The kit never uses the Skia path; this is recorded, not enforced.
